Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Archibald Zimonyi" <ar...@aranzo.netg.se> wrote in message news:1110979285....@o13g2000cwo.googlegroups.com...

> Hmm, my mistake.
>
> Follow up question since this is how I thought. A vampire with 1 vote
> is titled. If you have 0 votes and you gain an additional 1 then you
> have 1 vote, hence you are titled.

A vampire with a title is titled.
Having one vote doesn't inherently mean you have a title.

Independent vampire crypt cards that have "<name> has <N> vote(s)" printed
on their crypt card have the "<N> vote(s)" title.
